description: New-immigration registry flows by available year, country and receiving-locality label. Not current population, language or individual voting. Unavailable years are not zero.

country.description: Published country-of-origin code, for example RU, or all for every published group. Use source groups as published; this describes arrival flows, not residents.

from_year.description: Inclusive first arrival year. Omit to start at the earliest available year; unavailable years are reported as missing, not zero.

limit.description: Maximum matching records per page, 1–50; default 10.

offset.description: Number of matching records to skip for pagination, 0–10000; default 0.

to_year.description: Inclusive last arrival year. Omit to end at the latest available year; must not precede from_year.

name: get_immigration
